title: The First Hike in Nearly Four Years
subtitle: On 7 October 2026 the RBI MPC raised the repo rate 25 bps to 5.50% and shifted stance to calibrated tightening. A composite castings CFO must reprice floating working capital, the August capex note, and covenant headroom before the board meets.
category: Monetary Policy, Cost of Capital and CFO Judgment
description: HBS-style teaching case dated 8 October 2026. Public facts from the RBI Monetary Policy Statement, 5 to 7 October 2026, the Governor's statement, The Hindu and Reuters. MPC unanimously raised the LAF repo by 25 bps to 5.50%. SDF 5.25%. MSF and Bank Rate 5.75%. Stance changed from neutral to calibrated tightening. Rate cuts off the table in the near term. Prior easing cycle cut 125 bps from 6.50% to 5.25% by December 2025, then four holds. Reuters: FY inflation forecast lifted to 5.2% from 5%; real GDP forecast to 7.1% from 6.7%. Governor: headline CPI expected to average almost 5.8% over the next three quarters; core inflation 4.4% this year. Composite firm: Narmada Alloys Pvt. Ltd. Composite decision-maker: CFO Arvind Deshmukh. Not a real filing.
thumbnail: REPO TO 5.50%. CUTS ARE OFF THE TABLE.
sources: Reserve Bank of India, Monetary Policy Statement, 2026-27, Resolution of the Monetary Policy Committee, October 5 to 7, 2026. Unanimous 25 bps hike in LAF repo to 5.50%; SDF 5.25%; MSF and Bank Rate 5.75%; stance changed to calibrated tightening.

Statement by Shri Sanjay Malhotra, Governor, RBI, 7 October 2026, and RBI YouTube live statement. Rate cuts off the table; next action a hike or a pause; stance change by a majority of 4-2; headline CPI expected to average almost 5.8% over the next three quarters; core inflation 4.4% this financial year.
The Hindu, 7 October 2026: first hike after the December 2025 cut to 5.25% and four subsequent holds; easing cycle of 125 bps from 6.50% to 5.25%.

Reuters, 7 October 2026: inflation forecast raised to 5.2% from 5%; GDP growth forecast raised to 7.1% from 6.7%; Sakshi Gupta, HDFC Bank, expects another 50-75 bps. Analyst view, not an RBI projection.
RBI, Monetary Policy Statement, August 3 to 5, 2026: repo held at 5.25%; stance neutral; GDP 6.7% and CPI 5.0% projections that the October resolution revises.
philosophy: AI generates. DATA informs. FINANCE measures. ACCOUNTING verifies. HUMAN JUDGMENT decides.
